settings.quote: Bought it for my dad — 26 years in the Marine Corps. He's a man of few words. He hung it over the fireplace the same day and just said, “Now that's a flag.”
settings.name: Sarah K.

settings.quote: I was worried it'd look like the printed stuff at the big-box stores. Then I picked it up. It's heavy, the eagle detail is unreal, and you can see where it was worked by hand.
settings.name: Mike D.

settings.quote: Third one I've ordered. One for the house, one for my brother's retirement from the Navy, one for my son's first home. This is what we'll pass down.

settings.title: Carved
settings.text: Solid American hardwood is cut and shaped into the waving flag — every ripple done by hand, so no two are ever the same.

settings.title: Burned & Detailed
settings.text: The eagle, stars, and stripes are burned and tooled into the grain. That's depth you can run your fingers across — not a printed picture.

settings.title: Sealed, Signed & Shipped
settings.text: A hand-rubbed finish protects it for decades. The maker signs and numbers each piece, then it ships free — insured, with hanging hardware included.
Lifetime craftsmanship warranty on every carving

settings.question: Is it really handmade in the USA?
settings.answer: Yes — every single carving is cut, burned, sealed, and signed in our American workshop. Nothing is imported, outsourced, or printed. That’s the whole point of this company.

settings.question: How big is it, and is it heavy?
settings.answer: Sizes are listed on the product page. It’s solid hardwood, so it has real weight to it — that’s the first thing people notice when they pick it up. Mounting hardware rated for the weight is included.

settings.question: How do I hang it?
settings.answer: It arrives ready to hang with keyhole mounts cut into the back and the hardware included. Most folks have it on the wall within five minutes of opening the box.

settings.question: How long until it arrives?
settings.answer: In-stock carvings ship within 1 business day, fully insured and free anywhere in the U.S. Most orders arrive in 3–5 business days. Made-to-order pieces show their build time on the product page.

settings.question: Can I give it as a gift?
settings.answer: It’s one of the most popular retirement, Veterans Day, and Father’s Day gifts we know of. Add a note at checkout and we’ll include a handwritten card — no prices on anything.

settings.question: What if I don’t love it?
settings.answer: Send it back within 60 days for a full refund — we even cover the return shipping. It’s a promise we can afford to make because returns almost never happen.

settings.title: Free Shipping
settings.text: Free, fully-insured delivery anywhere in the U.S. In-stock pieces ship within 1 business day.

settings.title: Easy Returns
settings.text: 60-day money-back guarantee. We even cover the return shipping — no forms, no hard feelings.

settings.title: Veteran-Owned
settings.text: Every carving is made start-to-finish by a retired U.S. Army veteran in his American workshop.
